name: Radial Neck Fracture in Children
definition: Pediatric fracture of the radial neck, usually after a fall, with treatment based on angulation, displacement and forearm motion.

investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Immobilization for suitable minimally displaced fractures
amber: Greater angulation/displacement may require reduction or fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-bhagna phenotype may be documented after modern alignment assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Pediatric fracture of the radial neck, usually after a fall, with treatment based on angulation, displacement and forearm motion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
